description: Table 1 of the 2026 mucosal-immunity workshop report, transcribed cell by cell. Six consortia presented their sampling methods, assays and platforms. This is the project's only non-synthetic measurement data: it describes how real ongoing trials measure, not what they measured. Every list below is verbatim from the table; the `mapped` fields are this project's interpretation and are marked as such.

source.caption: Sampling and Assays in Consortium Trials Presented at Workshop.
source.transcribed_by: hand, from the PDF supplied by Lovaltech

consortia.name: COMMUNITY
assays_verbatim: Mucosal antibody titres and viral neutralisation assays
platforms_verbatim: Adult stem cell derived nasal and lung epithelial organoids
objectives_verbatim: Humoral response to seasonal respiratory viral infections (influenza, RSV, SARS-CoV-2).
Compare antibody titres in URT against LRT.
Explore IgA transcytosis across the epithelium

consortia.name: GERMINATE
consortia.study_design: Non-randomised, open-label experimental medicine study of IN LAIV or challenge with IN GMP influenza A/Belgium/4217/2015 (H3N2)
assays_verbatim: Flow cytometry and single-cell RNA-sequencing for cellular response
objectives_verbatim: Compare immune response against influenza infection to nasal spray LAIV

consortia.name: MOVE
consortia.study_design: IN LAIV in children and adults
assays_verbatim: Antigen binding and viral neutralisation by mucosal antibodies

consortia.name: MUSICC
objectives_verbatim: GCLP-level antibody assays from blood and mucosa

consortia.name: Project NextGen
objectives_verbatim: Immunological diversity in the upper airways

consortia.name: VAXXAIR
consortia.study_design: Randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of IM inactivated influenza vaccine (IIV) vs. IN LAIV
lower_airway_verbatim: Bronchoscopy (BAL, bronchial brushing, forcep biopsies, bronchosorption, EBUS-guided lymph node FNA)
assays_verbatim: Flow cytometry and single-cell RNA-sequencing for cellular response comparing airway cells with PBMCs.
Humoral response (IgG/IgA titers) and antibody HAI assay
objectives_verbatim: Multifaceted characterisation of temporal mucosal immune response to LAIV vs IIV in adults.
Establish phase I clinical trial unit with pulmonary sampling expertise

method_mapping._comment: Verbatim cell text -> this project's SamplingMethod. Entries mapping to null are sampling the project's antibody-comparability model does not represent, and the reason is recorded rather than silently dropped.

method_mapping_notes.Environmental sampling (viral emission): Samples the air, not the participant. It carries no immune measurement, so it has no measurement context.
method_mapping_notes.Environmental sampling: Samples the air, not the participant. It carries no immune measurement, so it has no measurement context.
method_mapping_notes.Bronchoscopy (BAL, bronchial brushing, f: One cell lists five distinct procedures with different dilution behaviour. Only BAL is modelled; the others are recorded as unmodelled so the loss is visible.

assay_mapping._comment: Verbatim assay text -> this project's AssayType, plus the antibody isotype the cell names. null means the assay measures something other than an antibody quantity (cells, transcripts, virus) and therefore falls outside a comparability engine for antibody measurements.
